title: A Cover for the Ghost
author: Ulyana Marchetti
blurb: Lior Blackwood, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
